description: Change a webhook endpoint: its url, the events it gets, or switch it off and on with status. Only the fields you send change; events replaces the whole list. Needs the owner or admin role, and a key with no scope limits or a person's sign-in. Needs a claimed workspace: a sandbox key from self-registration is refused (403) until a person claims the workspace.

events.description: Replaces the whole list of events, at least one.

status.description: inactive stops deliveries; active resumes them.

url.description: Where to send events. Must start with https://.

webhook_id.description: The webhook endpoint UUID: id on a list_webhooks result.

name: update_webhook
